chunks: 3176 - And Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them both, said:

“The least of that by which the visitor of Abī ʿAbdillāh, peace be upon him, at the bank of the Euphrates is rewarded—if he recognizes his right, his sanctity, and his wilayah—is that what has preceded of his sin and what comes later will be forgiven for him.”

key_terms.وَوَلَايَتَهُ: his divinely appointed authority and wilayah

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام with recognition of his right and wilayah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the immense reward for visiting Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام by the Euphrates while recognizing his right, sanctity, and wilayah. It emphasizes that such ziyārah, when joined with proper maʿrifah, is a means of divine forgiveness for past and future sins.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3176 - Imam Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) said:

"The least reward for the visitor of Abu Abdullah (Imam Hussain ibn Ali (as)) at the banks of the Euphrates, if they recognize his right, sanctity, and authority, is that their past and future sins will be forgiven."
